selection_rule: Lexicographic: lowest seed-mean invalid rate, then mean KL, then ACF MAE, then p and ridge.
limitations: Conditional 32-update simulations: observed validation history and price anchors are supplied at every window.
All weights, residuals, scaling and histogram boundaries use training only; validation selects hyperparameters.
Existing preprocessing reads/audits the full day; no test model metrics or test-based choices are computed.
Invalid finite books remain in all distribution and ACF metrics. No clipping, sorting, rounding or repair.
Seed standard deviations measure innovation sampling variability, not independent days or confidence intervals.
KL depends on the declared binning and smoothing; 32-update ACF only measures short event-time dependence.
Depth SSIM and final test comparison are pending. TimeGAN has not been trained or evaluated.
The lowest invalid rate is ranked first even when another candidate has lower KL or one-step MSE.
Candidate fit time includes an equal share of the order's SVD setup plus its own ridge solve/residual calculation.
Rollout timing excludes decoding and IO; initial smoke timings are historical and reported separately.

fit.solver: CPU float64 SVD least squares; unpenalised intercept
fit.ridge_objective: mean over training pairs of squared vector error + ridge * sum(weight ** 2)
fit.fit_scope: All consecutive feature pairs within training; includes pairs between windows and the trailing rows.
fit.context_scope: Training window starts after the first window; paired previous features and same-state price anchors.
limitations: Training MSE is an in-sample fit statistic, not validation or simulation quality.
Joint empirical residuals retain simultaneous dependencies but are sampled independently over time.
No price-ladder, spread or non-negative-volume constraints are enforced.
A spectral radius below one describes linear mean dynamics, not validity of generated order books.
Validation/test files are loaded by the existing audit, but no held-out features enter fitting or contexts.

generation.timing_scope: Feature rollout only; excludes model loading, context selection, decoding, file IO and plotting.
generation.initial_state_policy: Paired previous feature and price anchor sampled from training; all returned updates generated.
generation.status: Fit/save/reload/generate smoke test only; no held-out quality evaluation.

initial_experiment.scope: Preserved original AR(1) training-context smoke test; not the current validation run.
